installBannerDescription: Add it to your device for quick, offline access.
updatePromptDescription: A new version of RemindIt is ready.
installInstructionsDescription: RemindIt works best installed, with offline access from your home screen or dock.
installIosTitle: Add to your iPhone or iPad
installIosStep1: Tap the Share button (the square with an arrow) in Safari.
installIosStep2: Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen".
installIosStep3: Tap Add in the top-right to confirm.
installMacStep1: In Safari, choose File ▸ "Add to Dock", or open the Share menu.
installMacStep2: Confirm RemindIt to add it to your Dock.
installAndroidStep1: Open your browser menu (the three-dot or three-line icon).
installAndroidStep2: Tap "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".
installOtherStep2: Choose "Install RemindIt" or "Add to Home screen".

aboutTagline: RemindIt is a Progressive Web App for managing your personal shopping list. Add it to your home screen and it works offline — your data stays on your device.
aboutIncludedSubtitle: Everything shipping in the current release, at a glance.
aboutFeatureOnboardingDesc: : a quick 4-step setup shows you the app in action, rolls a random profile (avatar + handle), and lets you pick a starter catalog before landing on your list.
aboutFeatureProfileDesc: : manage your name and username, change your avatar, restore a backup, switch your starter catalog, pick a color palette, and reset or reseed your data — all from one place (tap your avatar in the menu).
aboutFeatureList: Build your list by tapping items; tap again to remove them. Your list is grouped by category and you can check items off as you shop.
aboutFeatureQuickAddDesc2: in the floating row at the top of your list to add a new item — a grouped autocomplete suggests items by category and surfaces your recommendations as you type. When creating a new item, category pills appear below the results: tap a pill to create in that category immediately, or press

aboutFeatureCatalogDesc1: : manage items and categories in collapsible sections sorted by how often you reach for them, with items alphabetically sorted (A–Z) within each category. aboutFeatureRecommendationsDesc: : colored pips mark items that are overdue or due soon based on how often you buy them, and learn from your history the more you shop. A count next to each category name in the catalog tells you how many of its items are recommended right now.
aboutFeatureHistoryDesc: : review your recent shopping in the History tab — your last 7 days of adds and removes, grouped by day, so you can see what you’ve picked up and what’s still pending.
aboutFeatureShareDesc1: : turn the list you still need into a polished image from the menu — items grouped by category with their colors, ready to

aboutFeaturePalettesDesc: : choose a categorical palette (Van Gogh is the default) with a live preview; it colors categories and items consistently across the app.

aboutFeatureLanguageDesc: : pick your language in the first onboarding step or switch anytime from Profile — the whole UI follows (switching reloads the app).
